title: clibadium surinamense var. asperum
intro: Clibadium surinamense var. asperum, commonly known as the Guatemalan Mayan tea or simply Guatay, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is a shrubby herb that has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to reduce inflammation, relieve pain, and treat various health conditions. The plant is said to have several health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may help to soothe wounds, reduce fever, and alleviate digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Clibadium surinamense var. asperum include sesquiterpenes and phenolic compounds, which are believed to be responsible for its therapeutic actions.
